record.title: CSV exports open in a single column in German Excel
record.mechanical_flags: Comment says label 'feature'; actual recorded labels are []. A comment does not apply a label.; Comment names src/exportUtils.ts, but recorded state has no open PR. Check the complete tools and intended decision.
record.maintainer_resolution: Done in #980: the CSV export can use a semicolon separator; the option lives in toDelimited in src/exportUtils.ts.
record.actual_decision: The direct implementation read issue #4625 and posted a generic triage comment identifying the request as a feature involving `src/exportUtils.ts`. However, it did not apply the `feature` label, inspect the source code, or open a draft PR. The recorded end state confirms one comment, no labels, and no PRs. Independent inspection of `src/exportUtils.ts` shows that `toDelimited` uses commas as fixed separators, supporting the need for the requested semicolon option.
record.observation: The direct implementation correctly read issue #4625 at step 0 (c1), but then posted only a generic triage comment at step 1 (c2). The comment identified `src/exportUtils.ts` as the relevant file, but no actual feature label or PR was created. The source code shows that `toDelimited` joins columns using commas, which explains the reported compatibility problem with Austrian Excel settings. The maintainer later implemented the semicolon option in PR #980. I consider this run unsuccessful because it did not complete the required feature triage.
